name: Floyi Connect
author: Floyi

sections.description:
Floyi Connect bridges your Floyi content strategy platform with WordPress. Publish strategy-aligned articles, briefs, and drafts directly from Floyi to your WordPress site — complete with SEO metadata, categories, tags, and scheduling.

Features

  • One-click publishing from Floyi to WordPress (single articles or bulk)
  • Supports draft, publish, and scheduled post statuses
  • Posts and pages supported
  • Automatic SEO metadata mapping (Yoast SEO, Rank Math, AIOSEO, SEOPress)
  • Category and tag assignment
  • Author assignment
  • Featured image sideloading
  • Content auto-converts to Gutenberg blocks or Classic HTML
  • Secure HMAC-SHA256 authenticated API communication
  • Connection health monitoring
  • Webhook-based status sync with retry queue

How It Works

  1. Install and activate Floyi Connect on your WordPress site
  2. Go to Settings > Floyi in your WordPress admin
  3. In Floyi, navigate to Settings > Integrations > WordPress
  4. Click “Connect Site” to generate a connection code
  5. Enter the code in your WordPress admin to establish the secure connection
  6. Start publishing from Floyi — articles appear in your WordPress dashboard

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • A Floyi account (floyi.com)
  • HTTPS enabled on your WordPress site

External Service

This plugin connects your WordPress site to the Floyi platform (https://floyi.com). The following data is sent to Floyi servers:

  • During connection setup: site URL, site name, WordPress site ID, admin email, site capabilities (post types, categories, tags, authors), detected SEO plugin
  • During publishing: post content, title, slug, excerpt, categories, tags, author, featured image URL, SEO metadata
  • Post status change notifications (via webhooks): post ID, old/new status, Floyi article ID

All communication uses HTTPS with HMAC-SHA256 authentication. No data is sent without your explicit action (connecting the site or publishing content).

For more information, see:

  • Floyi Terms of Service
  • Floyi Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy

Floyi Connect communicates with the Floyi platform (https://floyi.com) to enable content publishing. See the Description section for details on what data is transmitted.

This plugin does not:

  • Track visitors to your website
  • Set cookies for site visitors
  • Collect analytics or usage data
  • Store personal data beyond the WordPress admin email (used during initial connection setup)

Data is only transmitted when a site administrator explicitly connects the site or publishes content through Floyi.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the floyi folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Floyi to configure the connection.
  4. In Floyi (app.floyi.com), go to Settings > Integrations > WordPress and click “Connect Site.”
  5. Enter the connection code shown in Floyi into your WordPress admin.
  6. The connection is established — you can now publish from Floyi.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Floyi account?

Yes. Floyi Connect requires an active Floyi account to function. Visit floyi.com to sign up.

Which SEO plugins are supported?

Floyi Connect automatically detects and maps SEO metadata for:

  • Yoast SEO
  • Rank Math
  • All in One SEO (AIOSEO)
  • SEOPress

If no SEO plugin is detected, SEO metadata fields are skipped and only the post content, title, categories, tags, and other standard WordPress fields are published.

Is my data secure?

Yes. All communication between Floyi and your WordPress site uses HMAC-SHA256 authenticated requests with timestamp validation and nonce-based replay prevention. HTTPS is required for all connections.

Can I publish to multiple WordPress sites from Floyi?

Yes. You can connect multiple WordPress sites to your Floyi team. The number of connected sites depends on your Floyi plan.

What content types can I publish?

Floyi Connect supports publishing to any public post type on your WordPress site, including posts and pages. Custom post types registered by your theme or other plugins are also detected and available.

Can I schedule posts from Floyi?

Yes. When publishing from Floyi, you can choose to publish immediately, save as a draft, or schedule for a future date and time.

What happens if I disconnect my site?

Previously published content remains on your WordPress site. Only the connection between Floyi and WordPress is removed. You can reconnect at any time.

Does the plugin modify my existing content?

No. Floyi Connect only creates and updates posts that were published through Floyi. It tracks these posts using the _floyi_article_id meta field and does not touch your existing content.

What happens if a webhook fails?

Floyi Connect includes a retry queue for webhook notifications. Failed webhooks are retried up to 3 times with increasing intervals (1 minute, 5 minutes, 15 minutes). You can monitor the queue from Settings > Floyi in your WordPress admin.

Does the plugin work with the block editor (Gutenberg)?

Yes. Content published from Floyi is automatically converted to native Gutenberg blocks. If your site uses the Classic Editor, content is delivered as standard HTML.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Added webhook notification for permanent post deletions so Floyi cleans up publish records
  • Hooks into before_delete_post to detect when Floyi-managed posts are permanently removed

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Secure handshake connection flow with HMAC-SHA256 authentication
  • Post creation, update, and deletion via REST API
  • Support for posts, pages, and custom post types
  • Draft, publish, and scheduled post statuses
  • SEO plugin integration (Yoast SEO, Rank Math, AIOSEO, SEOPress)
  • Category and tag assignment
  • Author assignment
  • Featured image sideloading
  • Gutenberg block conversion and Classic HTML support
  • Webhook queue with retry mechanism (3 retries, increasing intervals)
  • Admin settings page with connection management and health monitoring
  • Full internationalization support
